description: Department of Local Government - Central Province - Notify the First Meeting of Kotagala PS and 31 other Local Government Bodies in Central Province
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the schedule for nominating Mayors/Chairmen and Deputy Mayors/Vice Chairmen for Local Government Institutions in Central Province. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including meeting dates, times, and locations for candidate nominations, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
